title: Chicken Parmigiana
description: Chicken Parmigiana is a beloved Italian-American classic featuring tender breaded chicken breasts, crispy on the outside and topped with rich San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese. Baked until golden and bubbling, this restaurant-quality dish is comforting, flavorful, and perfect when served with pasta or crusty bread.

ingredients.title: Chicken
items: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 6 oz each)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
Olive oil and a bit of butter for frying

ingredients.title: Sauce
items: 1 can (28 oz) San Marzano tomatoes, crushed by hand
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
½ cup fresh basil leaves, chopped

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Butterfly each chicken breast if thick, then pound to ~½ inch thickness using a meat mallet.
Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Set up a breading station:
Bowl 1: Flour
Bowl 2: Beaten eggs
Bowl 3: Breadcrumbs + Parmesan + oregano
Dredge each chicken breast in flour → egg → breadcrumb mixture, pressing lightly to coat evenly.
Heat a mixture of olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the chicken 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown (it will finish cooking in the oven). Drain on paper towels.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Make the Tomato Sauce
steps: In a medium saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add onion and sauté until translucent, 3–4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Simmer gently for 15–20 minutes until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in fresh basil.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Parmigiana
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Spoon a thin layer of tomato sauce into a baking dish.
Place fried chicken on top.
Spoon more tomato sauce over each piece of chicken.
Layer mozzarella slices evenly over the chicken.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Bake
steps: Bake in the preheated oven for 15–20 minutes, until the cheese is bubbly and golden.
For a perfect golden crust, switch to broil for 1–2 minutes at the end (watch carefully).

instruction.title: Step 5 – Serve
steps: Garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve hot with spaghetti, garlic bread, or a simple arugula salad.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with spaghetti tossed in tomato sauce.
Pair with garlic bread and a fresh arugula salad.
Finish with extra grated Parmesan and fresh basil for restaurant-style presentation.

chefTips: Breadcrumbs: Use fresh, panko-style Italian breadcrumbs for a crispier crust. Toast them lightly before breading.
Chicken: Pounding ensures even cooking and tenderness.
Cheese: Fresh mozzarella gives creamy, melty perfection. Avoid pre-shredded mozzarella—it has anti-caking agents that affect melt.
Sauce: San Marzano tomatoes give authentic Italian flavor. Simmer slowly for depth.
